Alex H: Quick async — adding INC-901 postmortem action items to the tracking sheet: https://redwood.sheets/INC-901-actions. Please confirm owner/due or propose a reassignment. Ping here for followups.

Priya M: Got it, looking now. I'm assigned "validate canary rollback scripts" due 2026-03-18. Can we push to 2026-03-22? team has a release freeze this week.

Alex H: @Priya M — noted. 2026-03-22 works. Please update the sheet and drop an `@Alex H ack` when done.

Devin K: I can take "audit cache invalidation" instead. @Samira R — that depends on your infra change; what's the ETA for infra PR?

Samira R: infra PR in review: https://gh/redwood/infra/pull/842. Reviewer blocking (TP). Expect merge ~2026-03-19. If that lands, Devin can start 2026-03-20.

Devin K: perfect, i'll update owner and set 2026-03-23 as the due date.

Alex H: small ask — add a severity tag and whether it's blocking launch (yes/no) in the "impact" column. That helps PM triage.

Priya M: added. FYI item #1 = blocking, rest = medium.

infra-bot: deploy-check: infra/pull/842 passed CI on 2026-03-18 11:07 UTC :white_check_mark:

Samira R: thanks infra-bot. @Devin K I'll ping reviewers to speed this up.

Priya M: CR ping for rollback script: https://gh/redwood/ops/pull/1290 — @Devin K can you take a look? tiny change, just a string tweak.

Devin K: Reviewing now. Quick note: where should we store the roll-forward steps? Prefer to keep roll-forward + verification in the runbook: `/runbooks/inc901.md`.

Alex H: yes — link the runbook in the sheet. Use this snippet at the top of the runbook:

```
Postmortem INC-901 runbook:
- rollback: scripts/rollback_inc901.sh
- verify: /tools/healthcheck --service inc901
- owner: Priya M
```

Priya M: added runbook link and updated due dates. Priya M: :white_check_mark:

Alex H: Thanks all. Final ask — owners, drop a one-liner here when you've verified task completion. I'll close action items Friday EOD 2026-03-27 unless objections.

Samira R: Will do. Samira R: :+1:

deploy-bot: scheduled canary for INC-901 on 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC — watch for alerts.
